text:
Priya Nair: Quick sync — we need to align runtime + infra on metrics for the new zone dashboard. Scope: p50/p95 latency by zone, failover_count, traffic_split_ratio, quota_throttle_count, and active_connections. Want one canonical ingest path to avoid duplicates.
Jordan Lee: Agree. Question: what aggregation windows are we targeting? 1m for UI, 5m for alerting? Also: region vs zone label — which is the primary key?
Aisha Gomez: Runtime note: KV cache hits and batching change observed latency distribution. If we only tag by region we lose useful granularity. We emit per-zone metrics today but high-cardinality is real. Suggest: emit zone label but default rollup to region in the console.
Tom Chen: From infra side: we can emit both "region" and "zone" labels. But high-cardinality tenants (many small zones) will explode ingest cost. Proposal: keep zone, but limit cardinality by sampling tag set for low-traffic tenants.
Luca Romano: For naming/parity with other services, propose metric prefixes and explicit units, e.g.:
```
redwood.infer.latency_ms.p50{model="guanaco-13b",region="us-west-2",zone="us-west-2a"}
redwood.infer.latency_ms.p95{...}
redwood.infer.failover.count{failover_from="us-west-2a",failover_to="us-east-1a",route="/v1/generate"}
redwood.infer.traffic_split.ratio{route="/v1/generate",primary="us-west-2",secondary="eu-west-1"}
redwood.infer.quota.throttle_count{route="/v1/embeddings",api_tier="free"}
```
Luca Romano: Also recommend a single failover event counter with labels (from,to,reason) instead of per-region counters, easier to roll up.
Jordan Lee: For UI: we need 1m/5m smoothing options, and a toggle to show region-rollup vs zone-breakdown. Also want the ability to annotate a graph with rollout/traffic_split policy changes (timestamped).
Aisha Gomez: Runtime will emit latency histograms and derived p50/p95 at the source to reduce cardinality of downstream aggregators. We'll expose histogram buckets and computed percentiles. Need exact bucket plan — propose exponential buckets from 1ms to 10s.
Tom Chen: Ingest pipeline: infra will add a metric transform stage that can collapse selected low-cardinality label values into "_other" for cost control. We'll put that behind a flag per-customer.
Priya Nair: Quota metric design question: do we want quota_throttle_count by api_key, by route, or both? UI cares about route-level for customers, infra cares about api_key for billing.
Luca Romano: Both. Emit per_api_key in raw logs + a derived per_route counter for the dashboard. Name the derived metric redwood.infer.quota.throttle_count.route.
Jordan Lee: Failover impact: we also need a gauge for active_connections by region+route to compute fractional traffic diverted: redwood.infer.active_connections{region,route}. From that compute traffic_split_ratio = primary / (primary+secondary).
Aisha Gomez: One gotcha: batching behavior causes short-lived spikes in active_connections that look like failovers. Suggest smoothing by 30s window for active_connections before computing ratio.
Tom Chen: We'll add tags for rollout_id and policy_version on emitted metrics so Console can line up events with spikes. That will help root-cause.
Priya Nair: UX ask: Console should show an overlay for canary vs primary traffic share and an auto-generated note when failover_count > threshold. Also allow drilling into tenant-level throttles.
Luca Romano: For metric naming cleanup, propose final canonical list and a mapping doc that shows old vs new names. I'll draft that.
Priya Nair: Action items: (1) Aisha: propose histogram buckets and sampling rules by EOD Thu. (2) Tom: implement label-collapse transform + flag for customers, ETA next week. (3) Luca: draft canonical metric list + mapping, PR by Mon. (4) Jordan: Console UX mocks for region vs zone toggle and rollout overlay, share Thursday. I'll consolidate and schedule a 30m follow-up.
deploy-bot: Ingest pipeline v0.9 deployed to staging — metric transform stage behind feature flag "zone-cardinality-control".
Priya Nair: Thanks everyone — ack if you got the tasks. :thumbsup: 
Jordan Lee: Ack.
Aisha Gomez: Ack.
Tom Chen: Ack.
Luca Romano: Ack.
Priya Nair: I'll create a shared doc with the proposed queries and a template for telemetry contract. Will link here when ready. :spiral_note_pad:
